defensiveAbilities.name: Swarm Mind
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster doesn't have a single mind (typically because it's a swarm of smaller creatures), and is immune to mental effects that target only a specific number of creatures. It is still subject to mental effects that affect all creatures in an area.

defensiveAbilities.name: Cling
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature leaves the swarm's space

Effect The swarm takes 1d6 Untyped Damage damage as ants cling to the creature and continue biting, dealing 3d6 Persistent,piercing Damage damage. High winds or immersion in water reduces the DC of the flat check to end this persistent damage to 5. Any area damage dealt to the creature destroys these clinging ants.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swarming Bites
offensiveAbilities.description:
Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 3d6 Piercing Damage damage (Basic DC 21 Fortitude Saving Throw save). A creature that fails its save against Swarming Bites becomes Clumsy 1 for 1 round. If the creature attempts a concentrate or manipulate action while affected, it must succeed at a Basic DC 5 Flat or the action is lost; roll the check after spending the action, but before any effects are applied.

Effect: Swarming Bites
